No protected quantum link or shared entanglement is furnished. The same equally informed conventional protocol can perform the construction.

# Ordinary acquisition of a gap-certified NPT seed for the finite two-way factory

28 October 2026. Separate constructive candidate, conditional on receiving the neighboring finite factory. The filter mechanism is established entanglement-distillation machinery; the obligations here are ordinary encoder discovery, a quantitative acceptance/fidelity margin, finite raw-call caps and the same retained-frame interface. This is not a claim about arbitrary higher-dimensional NPT distillability or unassisted quantum capacity.

## 1. Promise and resulting interface

Use the same stationary/reset source, fixed four-real-coordinate encoder family, supplied rank bound, k-dimensional retained receiver frame and paid two-way classical/local-memory resources as the factory. Write J_x in REFERENCE-A-first, output-B-second order; dim A=2. Let partial transpose T_A refer to the known logical computational basis. Supply rational 0<mu<=1/4 and promise

    min_x lambda_min(J_x^(T_A))<=-2mu.                  (NPT)

No Choi state, negative vector, support subspace, filter or useful decoder is supplied. The warm phase uses only ordinary loss-state preparations. After warmup, actual Bell-half source queries and two local success filters create the resource; they are not relabelled ordinary queries.

The construction returns a fixed encoder x and local contractions F_A:C^2->C^2, F_B:C^k->C^2 such that, on one latent warm good event,

    J_f=(F_A tensor F_B) J_x (F_A tensor F_B)^*,
    a=Tr J_f>=mu,
    F=<Phi|J_f|Phi>/a>=1/2+mu/2.                       (1)

Both lower bounds hold together; no arbitrarily rare normalized-success claim replaces the raw source bill. A fixed success reservoir supplies the ordinary factory's recurrence input at gap g=mu/2. Its finite code-teleportation and complete-error conclusions then apply with the extra filter shortage debit.

## 2. Ten ordinary banks and a finite global negative witness

Use the accepted inverse-square positive-model fit, but set anchor trace tolerance

    delta_a=mu/4096, m_a=delta_a^2/8,
    n_a=ceil[(80 nextpow2(d r)/m_a) log(120 nextpow2(d r)/beta_t)],
    d=2k, r=min(d,3R).

Acquire ten ordinary T anchors, fit the same compact PSD lift with the same finite Slater/inward-rounding contract, and allocate failure beta_t across the banks. On the joint good event its real-x family obeys

    sup_x ||T_x(Hhat)-T_x||_1<=28delta_a.

# Independent receiving: finite learned two-way reference factory

28 October 2026. **PASS, conditional on the explicitly received source/control/frame/learner imports.** Bound manuscript: `FINITE_TWO_WAY_LEARNED_REFERENCE_FACTORY.md`, SHA256 `af2a155f109c33987f13f87511a5758315e605643f1bdf1938686a731283e1c8`.

Reviewer: `producer-workspace/audit_local_controls`. The scope is the NEW all-history composition: ordinary warm acquisition, fresh certification, actual pair preparation, fixed reservoirs, code teleportation, and typed reference substitution. Accepted Bures estimation, causal frame compilation, coherent optimization and five-qubit correction machinery were inspected as imports, not re-proved or re-executed. No quantum-source samples, hardware runs, or author-file edits occurred.

## 1. Warm discovery really supplies the required unconditional event

The received inverse-square baseline uses `delta=epsilon0/1024` and `m=delta^2/8`. Substituting epsilon0=2g gives exactly the displayed `delta_a=g/512` and m_a. The ten bank failures can be assigned beta_t/10 independently of the baseline's example budget tied to epsilon. The received bank formula then has logarithm `12D/(beta_t/10)=120D/beta_t`, exactly as used here.

The baseline's good-event policy regret is actually at most

`168(g/512)+(2g)/32 = 25g/64 < g/2`.

Its physical-model fitting, feasible decoder, grid and arithmetic allowances are retained, so the looser g/2 statement is justified. The frame change does not alter the source optimum; the guarantee is uniform in the latent coordinate.

For the fresh six-state holdout, the exact arbitrary-TP relation is `q=(2/3)(1-F)`. An F-estimation error g/4 corresponds to Bernoulli error g/6. Hoeffding therefore gives `2 exp(-n_v g^2/18)`, explaining the displayed n_v. This holds pointwise in the frozen training record and coordinate. Good training gives F>=1/2+3g/2, so good validation accepts; acceptance plus good validation gives F>=1/2+g.

Thus the union of all warm aborts and bad accepted seeds has probability at most beta_t+beta_v under the existence promise. This is an unconditional pre-reference event, not confidence divided by acceptance. Without that promise, only the false-acceptance statement survives; the manuscript correctly says so. All failed, unused and holdout calls count.
